summary: The 8-K reports a name change from Renewal Fuels, Inc. to American Fusion Inc., a domestication from Delaware to Texas, and a stock symbol change to AMFN, effective in early 2026. It also announces a new Government Procurement Services segment and an initial transaction supporting a Canadian Department of National Defence procurement requirement. No deal terms, prices, or shareholder actions are involved. This is a routine corporate update and operational announcement, not a special-situation event.
